name: Engineering Pack
description: Comprehensive 45-day hands-on engineering program covering software architecture, Linux systems, networking, cybersecurity, and practical AI automation.
overview: Engineering Pack is a 45-day intensive engineering exposure program designed to bridge the gap between academic education and industry engineering standards. Students learn to think, build, and solve problems using real terminal tools, cloud infrastructure, networking protocols, security audits, and system architecture.
curriculum_summary: 11 progressive phases covering systems software, cybersecurity, network protocols, Linux administration, AI integration, and capstone software architecture.
courses_modules:
Module 1: Software Architecture & Git Workflows
Module 2: Linux Systems & Shell Automation
Module 3: Computer Networking & Sockets
Module 4: Cybersecurity & Vulnerability Assessment
Module 5: Applied AI & System Telemetry
Module 6: Capstone Engineering Portfolio
phases_duration:
Phase 1-3 (Days 1-15): Systems & Command Line Mastery
Phase 4-7 (Days 16-30): Networking, Security & Cloud Protocols
Phase 8-11 (Days 31-45): Applied AI, Embedded IoT & Capstone Architecture
projects_summary: Network Packet Analyzer, Encrypted CLI Vault, Real-time Sensor Dashboard, AI Automated Code Inspector, Distributed Microservice Backend.
learning_outcomes: Systematic CLI fluency, network packet analysis, secure coding practices, REST API architecture, production deployment workflows, professional RFC documentation.
eligibility: Open to engineering students (CS, IT, ECE, EEE, Mech, Civil) and tech enthusiasts looking for hands-on systems experience.
program_specific_content: Includes 1-on-1 code reviews, industry mentor workshops, and portfolio verification upon completion.

name: Robotics Pack
description: Hardware and software integration program focusing on microcontrollers, ROS basics, kinematics, sensor telemetry, and motor control.
overview: Robotics Pack provides an end-to-end hardware-software integration experience. Learn microcontroller programming, real-time sensor processing, motor driver control, wireless telemetry, and Robot Operating System (ROS) fundamentals.
curriculum_summary: 8 modules ranging from embedded C++/Python for microcontrollers to kinodynamics, PID motor control, and autonomous navigation telemetry.
courses_modules:
Module 1: Microcontrollers & Sensor Electronics
Module 2: Actuators, Motor Control & PWM
Module 3: Wireless Telemetry (ESP32 / WiFi / BLE)
Module 4: Kinematics & Motion Control Algorithms
Module 5: ROS (Robot Operating System) Fundamentals
Module 6: Autonomous Rover Project Showcase
phases_duration:
Phase 1 (Days 1-10): Embedded Electronics & Sensors
Phase 2 (Days 11-20): Control Systems & Telemetry
Phase 3 (Days 21-30): ROS Integration & Autonomous Rover
projects_summary: Self-Balancing Robot Controller, Wireless Telemetry Dashboard, Obstacle Avoidance Autonomous Rover, ROS Navigation Node.
learning_outcomes: Hardware circuit design, embedded C++/Python mastery, sensor fusion, closed-loop PID control, ROS node communication.
eligibility: Students interested in Robotics, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems, Electrical, and Computer Engineering.
program_specific_content: Hands-on simulation kits, real-time telemetry debugging tools, and hardware hardware-in-the-loop testing guidance.

name: School Pack
description: Foundational computing, block & text programming, interactive logic, and beginner electronics tailored for school students.
overview: School Pack introduces young learners to first-principles thinking, computational logic, interactive Python programming, creative web design, and hands-on electronics.
curriculum_summary: Interactive modules building computational thinking, problem-solving skills, block-to-python transition, and beginner hardware projects.
courses_modules:
Module 1: Logic Building & Algorithmic Puzzles
Module 2: Creative Coding with Python
Module 3: Web Basics (HTML & CSS)
Module 4: Beginner Micro:bit / Arduino Electronics
Module 5: Interactive Game Development Project
phases_duration:
Phase 1 (Days 1-20): Computational Thinking & Python Basics
Phase 2 (Days 21-40): Web Development & Digital Interfaces
Phase 3 (Days 41-60): Hardware Electronics & Final Game Project
projects_summary: Interactive Story Game, Personal Portfolio Webpage, Smart Alarm System with Sensors.
learning_outcomes: Algorithmic thinking, Python syntax confidence, basic HTML/CSS layout design, safe internet practices, electronic breadboard prototyping.
eligibility: School students in grades 6 through 12 interested in technology and coding.
program_specific_content: Gamified learning modules, interactive weekly quizzes, and parent-mentor feedback progress reports.

name: Intermediate Pack
description: Designed for students seeking deep specialization in backend microservices, DevOps pipelines, containerization, and advanced system design.
overview: Intermediate Pack expands technical capabilities into scalable cloud architecture, Docker containerization, CI/CD pipelines, database indexing, distributed Caching, and secure API gateways.
curriculum_summary: Advanced engineering curriculum covering microservices design, Redis caching, PostgreSQL optimization, Docker & Kubernetes concepts, and OAuth2 security.
courses_modules:
Module 1: Advanced Data Structures & Concurrency
Module 2: Relational & NoSQL Database Optimization
Module 3: Microservices & Event-Driven Architecture
Module 4: Docker Containerization & CI/CD Pipelines
Module 5: API Gateways & OAuth2 Security Protocols
Module 6: Cloud Production Deployment Showcase
phases_duration:
Phase 1 (Days 1-15): High-Performance Code & Database Systems
Phase 2 (Days 16-30): Microservices, Docker & Event Streams
Phase 3 (Days 31-45): Security Gateways, CI/CD & Production Launch
projects_summary: Distributed Cache Engine, Rate-Limited OAuth2 API Gateway, Event-Driven Task Queue System, Containerized E-Commerce Backend.
learning_outcomes: Container orchestration, microservice isolation, database indexing strategies, asynchronous message queues, high-availability architecture.
eligibility: Students with basic programming knowledge in Python, C++, Java, or JavaScript looking to level up to industry backend engineer standards.
program_specific_content: Includes architecture design reviews, mock technical interview sessions, and production log analysis training.
